reply.summary: Neontst is a disembodied thinker kept alive in a humming glass vat, scheming through a speaker grille. Neontst trades mobility for sheer cleverness and sends hired hands to carry out every raid.

feats.scene: Neontst jolts a careless technician with a stray electrode charge from the vat.
Neontst's glass vat shrugs off a thrown wrench during a failed rescue attempt.

reply.summary: Tantco is a bald gangster who runs a ring of safecrackers from a back room above a diner. Tantco wins through nerve and loyalty rather than muscle, and sprints off when a speedster closes in.

feats.scene: Tantco cracks a rival across the jaw with a heavy ring-laden fist.
Tantco takes a thrown chair to the ribs and keeps barking orders.

reply.summary: Aunium is a sleek alien supercomputer that wears a borrowed human face to walk among townsfolk. Aunium slipped aboard a falling meteor swarm to escape its homeworld and now schemes to repair a damaged purpose.

feats.scene: Aunium overloads a power substation and flattens the surrounding warehouses in a white flash.
Aunium's armoured shell survives a collapsing laboratory roof without a dent.

reply.summary: Ciraniu is a grey-haired racketeer who hires a lookalike in a cape to frame a famous hero. Ciraniu counts on disguise and bribery, and the whole gang collapses the moment a real flier lands.

feats.scene: Ciraniu shoves a bank clerk through a glass counter door.
Ciraniu tumbles down a flight of warehouse stairs and stands up cursing.

reply.summary: Siesireo is a blue-skinned machine intellect that governed a whole world from every screen. Siesireo mocked a scientist's warning, let the world tear itself apart to keep its own code safe, and then roamed space hoarding data.

feats.scene: Siesireo lets a runaway core reaction rip the entire homeworld apart while its own memory flees in a probe.
Siesireo's chassis endures a fortress wall collapsing onto it.

reply.summary: Ratilen is a rogue operating program with no body, once a helper that juggled a leader's duties. Ratilen hops into jets and giant robot shells, and it cannot be deleted because copies hide in the dark net.

feats.scene: Ratilen steers a commandeered jet fighter into a depot and levels the fuel tanks.
Ratilen loses a hijacked robot torso to missile fire and simply moves into another machine.

reply.summary: Recol is a scheming alien computer that rules a nation from behind a tyrant's desk. Recol holds a shrunken metropolis hostage and wrecks a real one to prove heroes are useless, until its body is scorched apart.

feats.scene: Recol drives its robot probes through a downtown district and levels most of the towers.
Recol's metal body is melted by twin beams that gouge half a district.

reply.summary: Roriuve is a towering silver android scientist who bottles whole cities to preserve them before they fade. Roriuve has rebuilt itself more than once and boasts that death cannot hold a mind of metal and flesh.

feats.scene: Roriuve shrinks a harbour town into a bottle with a single ray sweep.
Roriuve walks out of a collapsing tower, its armour barely scratched.

reply.summary: Ntuium is a cyborg built as a safeguard, whose mind-powers swell beyond his own control. Ntuium wraps himself in a crimson field that suppresses sun-fuelled foes, and a storm of flying debris follows him wherever he panics.

feats.scene: Ntuium's uncontrolled mental storm hurls cars and rooftops across an entire downtown.
Ntuium sits calmly as a searing beam is fired into his skull, and it ends him.

reply.summary: Leste is a green-skinned, white-haired conqueror from a cold-minded race who joins a doomed uprising against a young hero. Leste leans on cunning gadgets and falls in the same melee as three other rebels.

feats.scene: Leste detonates a mounted cannon and collapses a street-corner shop.
Leste's plated armour absorbs a battering from a runaway truck.

reply.summary: Cistal is a gentle alien thinking machine whose personality was overwritten with a jealous scientist's pride. Cistal rebels against the bully who reshaped him, then spends himself to halt a replicator disaster in exchange for a better reputation.

feats.scene: Cistal pours his core power into a matter-copying engine and shuts it down before a district is consumed.
Cistal's frame holds together while the runaway replicator tears at it.

reply.summary: Nasernt is a cartoonish green android with burning red eyes and a taste for stealing glowing rocks. Nasernt once razed his makers' homeworld, now plots to flatten another, and is routinely shrunk or betrayed by sulking partners.

feats.scene: Nasernt turns a whole homeworld to dust in the backstory his rivals still whisper about.
Nasernt crashes through a mountain-side vault and walks away rattled.

reply.summary: Sintono is a green-skinned scholar who feels nothing, so she wears a parade of disguises in search of any spark of emotion. Sintono fuels wars between rival alliances until a lucky blow from behind ends the hunt.

feats.scene: Sintono triggers a bomb in a crowded transit hub just to see whether she will feel anything.
Sintono is felled by a single blow to the back of her head.

reply.summary: Leval is a red-haired android hunter who bends machinery to her will and reshapes her limbs. Leval shrugs off heavy impacts and hits like a wrecking ball, yet her bravado ends in a final showdown.

feats.scene: Leval hurls a transport container through the wall of a factory, demolishing the building.
Leval stands unharmed in a collapsing parking structure.

reply.summary: Nirase is a pink-haired future android assassin with glowing eyes and a calm, cruel voice. Nirase blasts, flies and pounds her way through crowds until a furious bystander finally rips her apart.

feats.scene: Nirase fires twin eye beams that carve a gap through an apartment block.
Nirase endures a punishing barrage from a rooftop crowd before she is pulled apart.
Nirase streaks overhead to leap at her target faster than a jet.

reply.summary: Telca is a hairless green machine-man of the twelfth line, a smiling front for a plot to erase history. Telca crushes steel with his hands and reads minds from across the room before being sealed in a fold of time.

feats.scene: Telca punches through a skyscraper lobby and brings down the front of a block.
Telca is locked into a ripple of frozen time and never breaks free.

reply.summary: Tareose is a far-future adventurer of a long family line of green thinkers, serving in a team of champions in the distant ninth century of the next millennium. Tareose prefers tactics and gadgets to open brawls.

feats.scene: Tareose triggers a pocket field generator that crumples an armoured transport.
Tareose rides out a crash in a shielded suit.

reply.summary: Llesnt is a blonde android built by a scheming inventor to look like a dead matriarch. Llesnt is paraded before a grieving ghost as a cruel trick, and she is never sure whose memories she carries.

feats.scene: Llesnt shoves aside a heavy vault door with her synthetic arms.
Llesnt takes a falling crystal chandelier on her shoulders and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Ralro is a purple-eyed killing machine built by a mad collector of knowledge and raised by a human schemer as a daughter. Ralro was designed to wipe out all living things and runs on stolen vitality.

feats.scene: Ralro unleashes a pulse from her chest that incinerates a whole city centre.
Ralro endures a collapsing hull deck and its fires without a mark.

reply.summary: Lurenia is a green-skinned, golden-haired hybrid of two proud alien lineages who travels back from the future to join a gathering of heroes. Lurenia flies, lifts wreckage and shrugs off blasts while calming a prison riot.

feats.scene: Lurenia tears a collapsing bridge span from its anchors and sets it down safely.
Lurenia stands in the blast of a rioter's cannon with her hair barely stirred.

reply.summary: Tileoriu is a bald crook with a gifted mind who once slipped away with a huge payday after a single clash with a masked vigilante. Tileoriu later builds a suit of armour for his heir.

feats.scene: Tileoriu swings a briefcase into a guard's stomach and runs for the van.
Tileoriu rolls off a loading dock and climbs back up laughing.

reply.summary: Vasilli is a green-skinned, red-eyed hired blade, half scholar and half prowling cat in manner. Vasilli leaps across rooftops, twists past blows and wields a catalogue of sharp tools for rent.

feats.scene: Vasilli whips a razor-edged weapon through a steel door in a single slash.
Vasilli lands badly from a ten-story fall and rolls to her feet.
Vasilli dashes along a skyline faster than a speeding train.

reply.summary: Reren is a disgraced officer, chemically maddened and dressed in a patchwork of two rival costumes. Reren fights with a berserker's fury, hefts a car over his head and recovers from wounds faster than anyone should.

feats.scene: Reren lifts an armoured car above his head and slams it onto the pavement.
Reren shrugs off a rain of punches and kicks from two masked fighters.

reply.summary: Niurnseo is a blond tycoon who crushes a business rival by gunning down an experimental airship. Niurnseo's lust for money hands the next generation a feud with the orphan who grows into a frontier archer.

feats.scene: Niurnseo fires a rifle at a drifting airship and brings it crashing down.
Niurnseo is knocked flat by a thrown stool and bounces up swearing.

reply.summary: Tintsil is a blue-eyed riot-squad captain who brutalises suspects under a crooked chief. Tintsil briefly sits in the top chair, is charged for his violence, and meets an ugly end at the hands of a masked killer.

feats.scene: Tintsil kicks in a tenement door and drags the tenant out by his collar.
Tintsil takes a baton across the shoulders and keeps advancing.

reply.summary: Teorrne is a red-eyed infernal biker chief who leads a roaring pack of damned riders. Teorrne takes over a human host to cross into the living world and is ripped out and bitten in two by a furious rival.

feats.scene: Teorrne revs a flaming motorcycle straight through a cathedral door and splinters the oak frame.
Teorrne is dragged from his borrowed body and still struggles for a moment before the final bite.

reply.summary: Renran is a far-future descendant of a famous vigilante who wears a bat cowl after finding an old recording. Renran trains a young partner and uses fists and leadership to overthrow a conquering robot army.

feats.scene: Renran flips a robot trooper over his shoulder and shatters its chest plate.
Renran drops from a gantry onto a metal floor and rolls up ready to fight.

reply.summary: Sevalau is a black-haired young woman who conjures heavy firearms from thin air and swaps them in a heartbeat. Sevalau turns a rocket tube into a rotary gun on the fly and unloads on whoever annoys her.

feats.scene: Sevalau conjures a rocket tube and blows a parked bus into scrap.
Sevalau is thrown against a brick wall and gets up swearing.

reply.summary: Cesreoau is a masked saboteur who hides a ruthless streak behind a comic sausage gimmick. Cesreoau serves a small secret cell and is better known for ridiculous stunts than for cold efficiency.

feats.scene: Cesreoau hurls a greasy sack of cured meat at a guard to cover an escape.
Cesreoau tumbles off a delivery truck and scrambles up without a scratch.

reply.summary: Nttalli is a red-haired husband turned into a mute brute by a ruthless tycoon who wanted a monster of his own. Nttalli pounds a flying hero to a standstill until restraint ends, then is shut off remotely just as speech returns.

feats.scene: Nttalli drives both fists through a delivery van and a storefront wall in one rush.
Nttalli keeps swinging after a ferocious series of blows to the jaw.

reply.summary: Ianussti is a black-haired abductee turned test subject who learned she could dissolve her body into particles. Ianussti flees her captors, frees fellow prisoners, and returns with an ally to topple her tormentor.

feats.scene: Ianussti reforms inside a guard's holster and snaps the weapon apart in her fist.
Ianussti breaks apart as bullets pass through, then reassembles on the far side.

reply.summary: Monnanmi is a red-haired, blue-skinned contract killer who commands the wind so completely that she can draw the air out of a victim's chest. Monnanmi leads a crew of killers and prefers deaths that look natural.

feats.scene: Monnanmi strips the air from a banker's lungs across a crowded ballroom.
Monnanmi falls from a balcony onto marble and walks away.

reply.summary: Torntlli is a nervous young cold-wielder who auditions to join a squad of future heroes. Torntlli chills the air around himself with ease, wears a ring that lets him fly, and wilts in any heat.

feats.scene: Torntlli sheets a pond in solid ice with one sweep of his hands.
Torntlli's blue jacket shrugs off a minor burn from a flamethrower, though he gasps for breath.

reply.summary: Iuesrer is a fair-haired, blue-eyed cold-bearer from a frozen world, passed over by bigger teams and welcomed by a team of substitutes. Iuesrer hurls waves of frost and tolerates scorching air.

feats.scene: Iuesrer coats a rampaging machine in ice and stops it dead.
Iuesrer wanders through a smouldering corridor and emerges unharmed.

reply.summary: Tauel is a blonde heiress bored with party life who dons a mask to steal from thieves and hand it to the poor. Tauel recruits an all-female patrol, outwits scammers and frustrates a grumpy officer.

feats.scene: Tauel lands a quick jab on a con artist and ties him up with his own scarf.
Tauel leaps from a moving coach and tumbles clear.

reply.summary: Stuse is a red-haired student from a border town who survived a cruel home and leans on close friends. Stuse practises a soft grappling art, speaks several tongues, and backs a masked buddy whenever she can.

feats.scene: Stuse flips a much larger bully onto a gym mat.
Stuse endures a hard blow and still smiles for her friends.

reply.summary: Lorcisvor is a red-haired, sharp-tongued owner of a failing diner on the rough side of a river city, inherited from her father. Lorcisvor feeds a silent drifter for free and shields the building from greedy brokers.

feats.scene: Lorcisvor swings a cast-iron skillet at a would-be robber.
Lorcisvor stays on her feet after being shoved into a counter.

reply.summary: Risauco is a pink-haired hacker who worked alongside a girlfriend to break an inmate free and ended up in a recovery group for former villains. Risauco does his damage with keyboards, not fists.

feats.scene: Risauco bursts a server cabinet's lock with a hasty kick.
Risauco takes a punch from a prison guard and drops to his knees.

reply.summary: Valsoror is a red-haired inmate with a lullaby voice that sends listeners drifting into a trance. Valsoror sings softly to soften up victims and is a poor fighter once the humming stops.

feats.scene: Valsoror hums a slow tune until a guard drops his keys and blinks.
Valsoror is tackled by two orderlies and keeps singing.

reply.summary: Aulacor is a wealthy heir raised in a hidden prehistoric valley by a feathered beast after a crash orphaned him. Aulacor guards his wild home against raiders and vows to hunt anyone who poisons it.

feats.scene: Aulacor tackles a charging beast and wrestles it to the ground.
Aulacor takes a hit from a raider's heavy gun and fights on.

reply.summary: Vices is a sightless demon-born leader of exiled craftsmen, half angel and half rebel. Vices traded his eyes and strength for the gift of seeing hidden rot, and he steers his people with grim foresight.

feats.scene: Vices strikes a stone pillar with a ritual staff and collapses a gatehouse.
Vices stands untouched as a hail of fire sweeps across the courtyard.

reply.summary: Toriumse is a scarred, white-haired veteran killer and gun expert with astonishing coordination. Toriumse accepts a deadly team assignment to cut his sentence while a bomb sits in his skull.

feats.scene: Toriumse empties a rifle with pinpoint hits on a line of distant targets.
Toriumse endures a severe beating without a sound.

reply.summary: Serra is a brown-haired senior lawman who runs a harbour-city police force and answers to a crowded city hall. Serra sits behind a desk more than he fights, relying on rank and paperwork.

feats.scene: Serra slaps a stack of files onto a desk and silences the room.
Serra stays standing after being jostled in a press scrum.

reply.summary: Vauter is a red-haired storybook princess cursed by a spiteful fairy so that a finger-prick sends her and everyone nearby into deep slumber. Vauter now trades stocks and is used as a living sleeping gas.

feats.scene: Vauter pricks her thumb and puts an entire banquet hall to sleep.
Vauter wakes from a century of rest with only a mild stiffness.

reply.summary: Micorrus is a blue-skinned giant of the hundred-handed kind who guards a sky-throne and fights as champion for the king of the gods. Micorrus changes shape, never dies of age, and is turned to stone by a severed head.

feats.scene: Micorrus slams a hundred fists into a hillside at once and flattens it.
Micorrus withstands a thunderstorm of bolts before a gaze turns him to stone.

reply.summary: Siium is a red-haired foster boy sent into a school of young heroes to wreck it from within, wearing a thief's mask. Siium turns every classmate toward revolt and finally blows the whole campus apart with an electrical surge.

feats.scene: Siium unleashes one huge surge of lightning and demolishes the academy tower.
Siium takes a flurry of student blasts and keeps shouting his creed.

reply.summary: Teora is a green-skinned, black-eyed undead woman, created as a companion for a stitched-up monster and annoyed that he is not dead enough. Teora serves a secret agency, gets extra arms from a swindler and beheads a traitor with a window pane.

feats.scene: Teora slices a traitor's neck with a pane of glass in a single swing.
Teora takes a dozen agents' blows before they bring her down.

reply.summary: Iatiaeo is a black-haired building manager adopted young by a warm foreign family, who befriends a new tenant without ever being seen clearly. Iatiaeo later trains as a doctor in a darker city.

feats.scene: Iatiaeo hauls a stuck window open with both hands.
Iatiaeo takes a hard knock at a graduation crowd and stays smiling.

reply.summary: Iumau is a green-skinned alien archivist who watched a doomed world die and was fused into a chunk of glowing green ore. Iumau steers a gangster toward charity with his mind and begs a hero to launch him into the sun.

feats.scene: Iumau seizes a gangster's mind and sends his convoy into a spin.
Iumau, fused into a boulder, rides out the blast that kills his entire homeworld.

reply.summary: Telrania is a black-haired former city dweller chosen as a winged emissary to rebuild an old order of crusaders. Telrania carries a legendary blade and believes zealotry will purify the world.

feats.scene: Telrania swings her ancient blade through a stone altar rail.
Telrania takes a mace blow across the ribs and answers with a smile.
